todo.title: Implement kitten aging, generations, and trait inheritance
todo.description: Austin wants a micro universe of growth with real changes over time. Kittens should age, eventually pass on, and leave behind offspring who inherit traits. This creates generational storytelling — the hallmark of great colony sims. Reference: CK3 trait inheritance, RimWorld aging. Kittens age through life stages (kitten -> adult -> elder). Elders gain wisdom bonuses but slow down. When kittens form partnerships (see relationship system), they can have offspring who inherit a mix of parent traits with small mutations. Deaths should be meaningful chronicle events. Generational depth gives players long-term attachment.
acceptanceCriteria: Kittens have an age property that advances with game ticks through stages: kitten (learning bonus, no work), adult (full capability), elder (wisdom bonus, reduced stamina)

Create a simple exploration system: player assigns 1-2 kittens to scout, expedition takes N ticks, outcome based on kitten traits (brave kittens find more, cautious kittens return safely).
